text:
katie: Heads-up — intermittent TLS/STREAM_CLOSED failures in our Kotlin sample app on Android emulator (Pixel 5). Works on physical device and CI macOS. :facepalm:

katie: Stacktrace: `javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: Connection closed by peer` after a 307 redirect when our AuthInterceptor triggers. Happens ~1 in 8 runs.

katie: Reproducer: Retrofit POST to /v1/generate with our `AuthInterceptor` + `RetryPolicy`. Full logs show okhttp `STREAM_CLOSED` followed by `Connection pool` warnings.

sanjay: thanks — does it happen with `adb reverse` or only emulator NAT/proxy?

katie: only emulator NAT. `adb reverse` stabilizes it. Suspect emulator network stack + connection reuse + redirect + auth refresh race.

jonah: emulator socket handling is quirky. Quick experiment: disable connection pooling in sample app to see if failure rate drops: ```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .connectionPool(ConnectionPool(0, 1, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS))
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(false)
  .build()
```

marta: if that helps, add note to onboarding docs and add an emulator job to samples/ci. We need to catch flakes.

katie: tried jonah's change — failures dropped from ~12% to ~2% locally, but saw one `STREAM_CLOSED` after a 307 redirect.

sanjay: might be our `Authenticator` doing a synchronous refresh that blocks pool threads during redirect. Can you paste the authenticator?

katie: ```kotlin
override fun authenticate(route: Route?, response: Response): Request? {
  synchronized(this) {
    val token = refreshTokenIfNeeded() // blocking network call
    return response.request.newBuilder()
      .header("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
      .build()
  }
}
```

jonah: network call inside `authenticate` can deadlock with connection pool on emulator. Two approaches: 1) use an auth client that has its own OkHttpClient without pooling; 2) do background refresh and let `authenticate` return null so a retry layer handles it.

marta: option 1 seems safer for sample code. Provide an `AuthClient` example with `ConnectionPool(0,...)` and short timeouts. Add sample to samples/android/auth-repro.

katie: pushed a minimal repro branch `katie/emulator-tls-fix` with the auth-client change and tests. Link: https://github.internal/redwood/samples/+/katie/emulator-tls-fix (internal).

ciara-bot: CI run queued for katie/emulator-tls-fix — emulator matrix (api27, api29) starting.

sanjay: also add entry in Kotlin SDK FAQ: "Why do I see TLS/STREAM_CLOSED on emulator?" Recommend: disable pooling for auth client, avoid blocking refresh in Authenticator, or use `adb reverse` during dev.

marta: I'll open the docs PR with bullet list, sample link, and a suggestion to run emulator matrix in samples CI. Can someone add an integration test that repros the pattern so we detect regressions?

katie: I'll wire the CI job and mark it flaky if nondeterministic. Assigning myself to follow up and submit PRs for samples + docs. :thumbsup:

jonah: tiny follow-up — set `callTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(30))` on the auth client so refresh can't hang emulator threads.

katie: will add that. Thanks all.
